exact target probing can therefore remain in native British National Grid instead of requiring web-map reprojection
DSP replaced legacy Esri image services with persistent WCS and WMS endpoints
WCS returns raw pixel data such as elevation and is the correct numeric route while WMS is display-oriented
the endpoint naming is intended to remain persistent across future updates
dataset contains locations of freehold registered property in England and Wales and is a subset of the full Index Polygons database
each individual polygon has a Land Registry INSPIRE ID related to a registered title
the polygon is indicative and cannot by itself establish the legal extent of a registered title
dataset is updated on the first Sunday of each month using the previous month's data
